description: This Java class defines a custom JSP tag for generating URLs for product images in an e-commerce application. It constructs image URLs based on merchant store data, image size, and request context.

classes.name: ShopProductImageUrlTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag handler that generates a URL for product images based on size and merchant store data.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Generates the product image URL and writes it to the page output.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Ends tag processing, allowing page to continue rendering.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size property representing image size.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size property for image size.
